title: The closed-immersion locus of a finite morphism under arbitrary base change
statement: Let f:Y→X be a finite morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let f₀:Y₀→X₀, b:Y₀→Y and a:X₀→X form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product]. If W₀⊆X₀ is open [def-weil-open-immersion] and the restriction f₀⁻¹W₀→W₀ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], then there is an open W⊆X such that f⁻¹W→W is a closed immersion and W₀⊆a⁻¹W. No flatness, finite-presentation or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on a, and W₀ is allowed to be empty.

source.place: Morphisms lemma-closed-immersion and lemma-support-finite-type (056J); Modules lemma-support-finite-type-closed. Finite-cokernel argument for the marked-open step of Tag 0GK7

proof.text: For a cartesian square and a point x of the new base, Mathlib isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback identifies the new fibre with the base change of the old fibre along Spec kappa(x) -> Spec kappa(a x). Install the proved source theorem IsClosedImmersion.descendsAlong_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasicompact. This residue-field map is faithfully flat: flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff and RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff give flatness and surjectivity, and an affine morphism is quasi-compact. MorphismProperty.of_isPullback_of_descendsAlong therefore descends the closed-immersion fibre condition. This is the proved private helper closedImmersion_fiber_descend; it does not assume flatness of the original base change.

Let W consist of points where the fibre of f is a closed immersion. For any x in W, exists_isClosedImmersion_restrict_of_fiber gives an open neighbourhood U on which f is a closed immersion. Every y in U is in W: the restriction has a closed-immersion fibre by base change, and the helper applied to the restriction square descends this to the fibre over y. Hence W is open by isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.

Restrict f to W. For x in W, its fibre is the base change of the closed-immersion fibre of f, so it is a closed immersion. Apply exists_isClosedImmersion_restrict_of_fiber to f restricted to W at every x. IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_forall_exists_morphismRestrict glues these neighbourhoods into a closed immersion over W. The arrow isomorphism morphismRestrictOpensRange identifies this restriction with pullback.snd f W.ι.

For x in W0, the assumed closed immersion over W0 has a closed-immersion fibre. Apply the private helper first to the restriction square over W0 and then to the supplied square H. The fibre of f at a(x) is a closed immersion, so a(x) belongs to W. This is precisely W0 <= a preimage W. Empty opens, sources, targets and fibres are included throughout.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_closedImmersion_locus
    {Y X Y₀ X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f]
    (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ X₀) (b : Y₀ ⟶ Y) (a : X₀ ⟶ X)
    (H : IsPullback b f₀ f a) (W₀ : X₀.Opens)
    (hW₀ : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd f₀ W₀.ι)) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd f W.ι) ∧ W₀ ≤ a ⁻¹ᵁ W
